The Fire Services Department received a report at 8.45am on Sunday of a No 1 alarm fire at a lower-floor residential flat at Lung Kwong House in Wong Tai Sin.
Firefighters arrived a few minutes later and extinguished the fire at 9.16am, 26 minutes after their arrival.

Genetic diversity is nature’s insurance policy – an evolutionary safety net that provides the building blocks for natural selection.
While members of the same species share a mostly identical genome, a sliver of unique genetic variants determines their individual traits. When this diversity erodes, and a population becomes more uniform, it could leave them vulnerable to the same threats and unable to adapt when new ones emerge.
